customManagers.description: Track the release tag each upstream schema lock pins. Renovate rewrites the version everywhere inside a match, so the match spans provider_version and the release asset names as well as the tag. The PR stays red until scripts/sync-upstream-schema-from-release.py refreshes the lock's sha256s. See anolishq/anolis-workbench#369.
Track the runtime and provider releases each bundled template pins under components, so Onboarding never deploys a stale runtime or provider. See anolishq/anolis-workbench#470.

Track sim-quickstart's compatibility pin for its sim0 provider. That entry is keyed by provider id and names no repo, so the depName is fixed here; it matches the components pin's depName, so both pins move in the same PR.

packageRules.description: Hold the TypeScript major: v7 is the native (Go) compiler, and the type-check toolchain (@typescript-eslint, svelte-check) still peers at typescript <6.1.0, so the major cannot install/type-check yet. Minor/patch keep flowing. Re-enable once that toolchain declares TS7 support. See anolishq/anolis-workbench#197.
